title: Learning the Average Dose-Response Function with a Right-Censored Treatment
abstract: arXiv:2611.19204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper considers estimation and inference for the average dose-response function under right-censored treatment duration and missing outcomes for censored units. Using the duration lower bounds provided by censored records, we construct a novel multiply robust estimator through augmented local estimating equations. Under suitable regularity conditions, the estimator remains consistent when any two of the outcome regression, treatment density, and censoring survival function are consistently estimated. We establish its convergence rate and asymptotic distribution within a cross-fitting framework under appropriate conditions on nuisance estimation. To address local smoothing bias that can distort confidence interval coverage, we further develop a debiased estimator that supports asymptotically valid pointwise inference without undersmoothing. Under additional uniform conditions, we construct simultaneous confidence bands using a Gaus

translated_title: 基于右删失处理的平均剂量-反应函数学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在处理时长右删失以及删失单元结局缺失情况下，平均剂量-反应函数的估计与推断问题。利用删失记录所提供的时长下界信息，我们通过增广局部估计方程构建了一种新颖的多重稳健估计量。在适当的正则条件下，当结局回归、处理密度和删失生存函数三者中任意两个被一致估计时，该估计量仍保持一致性。我们在交叉拟合框架下，基于对干扰参数估计的适当条件，建立了该估计量的收敛速度和渐近分布。为解决可能扭曲置信区间覆盖率的局部平滑偏差问题，我们进一步开发了一种去偏估计量，无需欠平滑即可实现渐近有效的逐点推断。在附加的一致性条件下，我们利用高斯近似构建了同步置信带。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于增广局部估计方程的多重稳健估计量，用于在处理时长右删失与结局缺失下估计平均剂量-反应函数，并通过去偏技术实现了无需欠平滑的渐近有效统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel multiply robust estimator based on augmented local estimating equations for the average dose-response function under right-censored treatment duration and missing outcomes, and develops a debiased estimator enabling asymptotically valid inference without undersmoothing.
